SELECT r.rule_num, CASE WHEN r.from_account_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'T' ELSE c.category_type END AS kind, r.category_num, c.category_name, c.category_emoji, r.account_num, a.account_name, r.from_account_num, f.account_name AS from_account_name, r.to_account_num, t.account_name AS to_account_name, r.rule_amount, r.rule_memo, r.repeat_type, r.repeat_month, r.repeat_day, r.start_date, r.end_date FROM recurring_rules r LEFT JOIN personal_categories c ON r.category_num = c.category_num LEFT JOIN accounts a ON r.account_num = a.account_num LEFT JOIN accounts f ON r.from_account_num = f.account_num LEFT JOIN accounts t ON r.to_account_num = t.account_num WHERE r.user_num = #{userNum} AND r.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.rule_num ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_rules SET category_num = #{categoryNum}, account_num = #{accountNum}, from_account_num = #{fromAccountNum}, to_account_num = #{toAccountNum}, rule_amount = #{ruleAmount}, rule_memo = #{ruleMemo}, repeat_type = #{repeatType}, repeat_month = #{repeatMonth}, repeat_day = #{repeatDay}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate} WHERE rule_num = #{ruleNum} AND use_yn = 'Y'
